articles.title: LA Schools Pull the Plug: Massive Screen-Time Limits Hit 400,000 Students
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Unified School District launched an unprecedented screen-time ban for its youngest students this week, with older grades to follow. Teachers are scrambling to adapt, calling the rapid rollout chaotic. The district hopes data from tracking software will guide future tweaks.

articles.title: Britain's Unrelenting Heat: Summer 2026 Poised to Shatter All Records
articles.summary: The UK is on the brink of its hottest summer ever, with average temperatures set to surpass 2025's record. A staggering 37 consecutive heatwave days and 38°C highs have fueled a historic drought, leaving 45 million people in drought zones and 27 million facing water restrictions.

articles.title: Poland Forges Ahead with U-20 Women's World Cup Despite UEFA's FIFA Boycott
articles.summary: Hosts Poland insist the Under-20 Women's World Cup will proceed in September, even as UEFA's 55 members boycott FIFA events over a governance dispute. France and New Zealand have confirmed participation, while the US is expected to attend. The tournament is a critical development stage for young players.
